game.name: Super Mario Galaxy
game.rules:
**Game Restrictions and Recommendations:**

- The game **must** be played on an authentic disc, Wii U Virtual Console, Switch (on Super Mario 3D All-Stars), or an allowed emulator. Loading the game through USB, Neogamma, NVIDIA Shield or any other means is **banned**.
- Game hacks, cheat codes (such as Gecko codes), custom textures, and other unofficial game modifications or releases are **banned**.
- Manipulating your Wii’s save data to skip the save textbox is **banned**.
- 2P/Co-Star runs are allowed.
- For Luigi runs, you may use a completed file found in the Resources tab.
- You may use Gecko to play discs from other regions on Wii or Virtual Wii.
- You may use any homebrew software, such as Mocha, Haxchi, Tiramisu, or Aroma, to install the game on the Wii U Virtual Console.
- You may use a homebrewed Switch for Super Mario 3D All-Stars.

**Submission Restrictions and Recommendations:**

- The **entire** run should have video and audio. Runs suffering from technical issues, such as stream crashes, may be given some leniency. Submissions **must** include the beginning and end of the run.
- Runs **must** be completed in a single segment (RTA). If you pause the timer, your run will be retimed.
- Please trim the submission video close to the beginning of the run or include a timestamp in the submission’s description.
- Twitch past broadcasts, Twitch highlights, and any download links will be **rejected**; we recommend submitting your runs via YouTube videos.
- Select the appropriate date, platform, and game region. Runs completed on Wii U using a disc should be submitted under “Wii” and not “Wii U VC.”
- Exclude milliseconds in full-game run submissions. Dome RTAs, Observatory RTAs, All Star runs, and Single Star runs **must** include milliseconds. Please use [vidtimer](https://vidtimer.com/) to retime your runs.
- If 2P/Co-Star mode was activated intentionally and used to save any time, please select “2P” under “Mode.” If 2P was activated accidentally but never used to save time, you may select “1P.” In this case, please timestamp where 2P was activated. Moderators will decide if the run used 1P or 2P if it’s not clear.
- If you choose to play with two runners, you **must** submit under the runner’s name who isn’t using 2P **for the majority** of the run. If you alternate controllers evenly, you may choose to submit under either runner’s name.

**Emulator Restrictions:**

- **Any** of the [released Dolphin emulator versions](https://dolphin-emu.org/download/?ref=btn) and [Lua Dolphin](https://github.com/MikeXander/Dolphin-Lua-Core) are the **only** permitted emulators. Development versions of Dolphin and any other emulators are **banned**.
- You **must** have FPS shown, either in the title bar or overlaid on the game itself.
- You **must** show the Dolphin version at some point in the video. This can be shown after the run for convenience.
- The "speed up disc transfer rate" or "emulate disc speed" option **must** be unchecked or set to undetermined (-) and **must** be shown at some point in the video. This may be shown after the run for convenience. **Every** type of run **needs** to show this option, **except** for single star runs.
- The game **must** be running at 60 frames per second. Higher frame rates are **banned**. Occasional frame drops or lag spikes are acceptable but runs that have **significant frame drops** or heavy lag **may be rejected**.
- You may use any controller, including a keyboard and mouse. **All** runs that specifically use a keyboard and mouse **must** show a visual input display. **Any other controllers are exempt from this rule**.
- Runs recorded through Dolphin’s movie recording feature will be **rejected**.
- Save states are **banned.** They may be used outside of runs to reset or practice.
- Slowing down the game intentionally is **banned**.
- Decreasing load times intentionally is **banned**.

categories.name: All Stars (Luigi)
categories.rules:
**All Stars Objective:**

- Obtain all stars in a galaxy as Luigi. You may use a completed file.

**Timing:**

- Time begins when selecting the first star in the star select menu and ends on the first frame of the star cutscene upon obtaining the last star in the galaxy.

categories.name: Single Stars (Luigi)
categories.rules:

- Beat a level as Luigi. You may use a completed file.

**Timing:**

- Time begins when selecting a star in the star select menu and ends on the first frame of the star cutscene upon obtaining the star.

runList.comment: first sub 2:20, I just can't man

After a year and a half of constant grinding I finally made my childhood dream come true, when beginning my grind of this game in November 2022 I was not sure what was going to happen. I wasn't too familiar with speedrunning and only dabbled in a couple games such as Minecraft and Disney Infinity, but I always knew I wanted to speedrun this game from the very first time I got into the hobby. The nostalgia I have for Super Mario Galaxy and 2 is unparalleled to any other game, just hearing the music of this game gives me goosebumps its that special to me. I remember sitting in my room one night and being amazed by the terrace dome and how you could go to different planets, it was just so different to anything I had ever seen. The atmosphere of Super Mario Galaxy is way ahead of its time and I believe that's why I have such a strong connection to this game;

I have always loved Mario games, but this was something out of this world.

twitch vod:https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2167373115
